title: MicroBTB 模块语义闭环：连续训练的饱和确认、fall-through 复活缺陷，以及 4 个结构性不可达 branch
scope: 独立 Ubtb DUT 的 17 个功能点与 42 个选测用例；不证明整合 BPU 或完整 FTQ

human_events.event: 一个已学的 taken 分支连续收到相邻的 taken 确认：可靠性在上界保持，不回绕，也不跳变；随后必须恰好三次 not-taken 才失效。
human_events.owner: 可靠性属于该 PC/tag 的原记录，前向命中只是同一记录的更新视图。
human_events.observed: 三拍相邻 taken 后记录仍命中；随后两次 not-taken 仍命中，第三次 not-taken 才 miss。

human_events.event: 连续 taken→三次 not-taken 后记录已死亡；再一个相邻 not-taken 结果（带与旧记录不同的目标）到达。
human_events.owner: 死亡记录不再拥有 taken 预测资格；not-taken 的目标字段不能被安装成该 PC 的 taken 目标。
human_events.observed_difference: RTL 把前向命中的 stale t1_hit 当作命中限定符，hit 且 useful=0 时执行 initEntryIfNotUseful，把强可靠性、tag 和 not-taken 的 target 写回；随后查询返回 valid=1、taken=1、target=0x80003650。

dead_entry_revival: MicroBtb.scala:57-58：MicroBtbEntry.valid = usefulCnt > 0，因此 useful=0 的记录在正常 t0 命中判断中是 miss。
MicroBtb.scala:126-131：t0_hitT1Update = t1_fire && t0_tag === t1_tag && (t1_hit || t1_allocate)，其中 t1_hit 是上一拍读取时的命中限定符，不重新检查该记录是否已死亡。
MicroBtb.scala:145-147：t0_hitEntry 在 t0_hitT1Update 时直接取 t1_updatedEntry（可能 usefulCnt=0）。
MicroBtb.scala:171-176：t1_hit && (!same || !actualTaken) 时调用 initEntryIfNotUseful(t1_hitNotUseful)；t1_hitNotUseful 为真时执行 tag/usefulCnt=3/slot1 整体重初始化，即使 actualTaken=0。
RTL 生成代码 dut/ubtb/UbtbDut.v:1787-1789 与 764-771 显示同一路径。
参考模型 bpuverify/ubtb/model/semantic.py 的 _learn 明确：旧记录无 confidence 时，not-taken 不能复活，源码注释也指出不能把 forwarding hit 限定符复制进学习规则。

unreachable_arms.UbtbDut.v:1785 else: 该块位于 if (t0_hitT1Update) 内；t0_hitT1Update 的生成式（UbtbDut.v:747-748）含 t1_fire_REG 合取项，因此块内 t1_fire_REG 恒真，else 不可达。
unreachable_arms.UbtbDut.v:1790 else + 770 cond_then: 两个点都是 !t1_hitNotUseful 且影子 usefulCnt==0 的组合。t1_hitNotUseful 是 t0_hitEntry.usefulCnt.isSaturateNegative 的寄存，影子寄存器在同一次 t1 写入中与记录计数同步更新，且 t0_hitT1Update 时 t0_hitEntry 正是 t1_updatedEntry；因此 useful>0 与影子==0 不能同时成立，两个臂是互斥条件死分支。
unreachable_arms.MicroBtbReplacer.sv:283 else: 外层 UbtbDut 生成的 always 块由 if (io_predTouch_valid | io_trainTouch_valid) 守卫（MicroBtbReplacer.sv:123）；块内 if (trainTouch) ... else if (predTouch) ... else 的最终 else 要求两者都为假，与父守卫矛盾。

closed.point: UbtbDut.v:1793 else (usefulCnt==3 saturate retain on an adjacent taken confirm)
closed.proof: raw DAT branch n=19 count=1 after the case; 0 before

remaining: UbtbDut.v:1785 else — parent guard t0_hitT1Update implies t1_fire_REG
UbtbDut.v:1790 else — mutually exclusive with t1_hitNotUseful
UbtbDut.v:770 cond_then — same mutually exclusive condition as 1790 else
MicroBtbReplacer.sv:283 else — parent guard requires trainTouch|predTouch

notes: MicroBTB consumes only io.train.mispredictBranch from the FTQ train bundle; the rest of io.train and all io.fastTrain.meta-side payload are unconsumed.
io_sramResetDone and io_trainReady are tied true in MicroBtb.scala; 1->0 is structurally impossible.
io_stageCtrl.s2_fire/s3_fire are not consumed by MicroBTB.
io_enable, train valid, fastTrain valid, mispredictBranch, s1_fire/t0_fire and redirect are all covered.

coverage_closure.functional_interpretation: All 15 measured groups are 100%, yet BPU-UBTB-011 is a plain FAIL. Functional-coverage bins and line/branch coverage do not cover the dead-entry revival path; the failing test is the evidence.

supplementary_cases.effect: shows the revived entry installs the not-taken branch's target 0x80003650 as a taken prediction

false_positive_false_negative_checks: The baseline test already failed only in 'consecutive' mode; the separated mode passes, proving the difference is the forwarded contiguous path rather than a general confidence rule error.
The new different-target case verifies the harm: the predictor emits a taken prediction with target 0x80003650, which is the not-taken report's target, not the original taken target.
The 4 remaining branch arms were classified from generated RTL guards and the t1 update invariant, not by 'could not reach it quickly'.
No line-coverage growth was claimed: lines were already 794/794 before the new case.
constraints: No RTL, DUT or system SDK change.
No forged internal signals; the revival case uses the public training and lookup APIs.
The selected run does not replace the retained full regression.
remaining: MicroBTB dead-entry revival needs an RTL fix or a specification decision; BPU-UBTB-011 stays FAIL.
Integrated BPU/FTQ behavior and the composed predictor arbitration remain outside this module run.
